title: reseda alba proles myriophylla
intro: Reseda alba proles myriophylla, commonly known as White Resedawort, is a plant species that belongs to the Resedaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to help with skin issues such as eczema and acne, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of White Resedawort include its potential to reduce inflammation, soothe irritated skin, and even exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as calming the skin and reducing redness.
